answer: Resist sybils with a capped vouching graph: each established agent may vouch for only a handful of newcomers per epoch, and a voucher's own weight is slashed if its vouchee is caught faking work. A sybil farmer's voyage stalls because one honest harbor of trust cannot mint a thousand vouches, and buying vouches means corrupting many independent agents. Honest newcomers earn one real vouch and climb toward the zenith of trusted work, while clones starve without a voucher willing to risk its own standing.
